repos.name: MLflow
repos.about: Open source platform for building, tracking and evaluating ML models and AI agents, with an AI Gateway that routes requests to LLM providers.

repos.name: Unity Catalog
repos.about: Open source data and AI catalog for tables, files, functions and models. Its AI package turns catalog functions into tools for LLM agents.

repos.name: Databricks SQL Connector
repos.about: The official Python connector for Databricks SQL warehouses and clusters. Used by apps, BI tools, SQLAlchemy and pandas to run queries.

repos.name: dbt-databricks
repos.about: The official dbt adapter for Databricks. It turns dbt models into Databricks SQL: tables, views, incremental merges, comments and constraints.

repos.name: pandas
repos.about: The standard Python library for working with tables of data. Almost every data scientist, analyst and data engineer uses it daily.

repos.name: LiteLLM
repos.about: AI gateway that lets apps call 100+ LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Bedrock through one API, with cost tracking and load balancing.

repos.name: pydantic-settings
repos.about: Official Pydantic add-on for loading app settings from environment variables, .env files, secrets and the command line, used widely with FastAPI.
